title: Arista Networks security advisory (AV26-1015)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1015 Date: October 7, 2026 As of October 6, 2026, Arista Networks is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: CloudVision CUE Version 2026.2.0 and prior Version 2021.2.0 and prior Version 2022.2.0 and prior Version 2022.3.0 and prior The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Security Advisory 0190 Arista Networks Advisories & Notices Article Link: Arista Networks security advisory (AV26-1015) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
